notes: §1985:XI.4.2.3 SR2: "A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement for the file-name whose sort-merge file description entry contains record-name-1." WalkProgram calls GateReleaseReturnRange below 2002, which seeds ProcedureReach.Closure (followGoTo) with the input procedures of SORTs naming the file and reports COBOL7081 for a RELEASE outside; but it collects only statements at pc >= EntryPc, so a RELEASE in the DECLARATIVES is never asked, even in a program with no SORT at all (no range exists), and Closure does not follow CALL although §1985:XI.4.4.4 GR7 puts statements executed via CALL in the range. Probes at 85 (b/c/e/a): both witnesses refused COBOL7081 (accepted at 2002); RELEASE in an output procedure, in the main line after the SORT, in the paragraph after a one-paragraph input procedure, and in a MERGE output procedure refused; reached by PERFORM ('AAA','CCC'), by GO TO plus fall-through ('MMM','ZZZ'), by an ALTERed GO TO ('PPP','QQQ'), in S1 THRU S2, and in a paragraph also performed from outside accepted and ran. Defect: a declarative RELEASE in a program with no SORT compiles and runs silently. Lead (not decided here): a RELEASE in a contained program CALLed from the input procedure, of an SD record IS GLOBAL (legal per §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1), is refused COBOL1757 citing ISO §2023:13.18.27.3 SR3, which has no 1985 counterpart found; GateReleaseReturnRange would refuse it too since Closure does not follow CALL. kb/Work PB5572 holds the defect (code read: op-20261114/out-read6/rd-02.json; rerun op-20261114/records-read6/rerun-log.txt).

next.reason: 1985 states as a syntax rule that 'A RELEASE statement may be used only within the range of an input procedure associated with a SORT statement' for its file, so a violating program is refused. 2023 has no such syntax rule (14.9.32.3 SR1-4 carry none); §2023:14.9.32.4 GR1 says it 'may be executed only' there and 'If it is executed at any other time, the EC-FLOW-RELEASE exception condition is set to exist', and §2023:14.9.40.4 GR13 sets EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE when an output procedure's range executes a RELEASE. A compile-time refusal became a run-time exception condition.
